SKILL.md: description: Use when someone asks how the business did or where it stands according to the books in oryh — 看利润表（损益表：某月、某季度、本年累计，与上期或去年同期对比，按项目、成本中心、客户或月份拆分）和资产负债表（某日资产、负债与所有者权益） — every figure is a sum of posted journal entries; you read and explain, you post nothing. Requires ledger.read.
